Pipeline step — orders_daily
pipeline/orders_daily.py: test passed, 4 rows in, 2 rows out

## Source
- data/orders.csv — order_id (int), customer_id (int), placed_at (text, ISO date-time), total (text: "£12.00", sometimes empty) — sample: all 4 rows

## Transform
- pipeline/orders_daily.py `daily(rows)` — parses total to pence (int) and placed_at to a day, sums orders and pence per customer per day; drops rows with an empty total, counted and printed

## Output
- out/orders_daily.csv — day, customer_id, orders, pence — sample run wrote 2 rows

## Checks
- rows out ≤ rows in; no empty day or customer_id; pence ≥ 0

## Run
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_orders_daily.py` → `1 passed in 0.10s`
- `python pipeline/orders_daily.py data/orders.csv out/orders_daily.csv` → `2 rows written, 1 dropped`
- the Makefile runs steps by name: add `orders_daily` to `STEPS` in Makefile:1
